title: 急救基础与常见外伤
source_doc: course/高校实验室安全/158_急救基础与常见外伤.md
author_source: project/高校实验室安全/158_急救基础与常见外伤/src.py

points.K4: 割伤刺伤：冲洗按压包扎
points.S2: 出血多：用力按压快呼救
points.K7: 吸入误食：离开现场不催吐
points.S3: 骨折固定，脊柱伤不搬动
points.K10: 昏迷有呼吸：侧卧防窒息

shots.scene: 欣欣抱着一个急救箱
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot holds a first aid kit with a white cross in its arms, looking at the camera.
shots.narration: 第14章第四课：急救基础与常见外伤。

shots.scene: 欣欣竖起手指，身旁是时钟和心形
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot raises a finger, a clock and a heart icon floating beside it.
shots.narration: 正确的现场处理，能为救治赢得时间。

shots.scene: 阿杰清洗烧杯，杯子碎了划破手指
shots.prompt_en: In a university lab, the young male student washes a beaker at a sink, it breaks and cuts his finger, a little blood.
shots.narration: 阿杰洗烧杯时，杯子碎了，划破了手。

shots.scene: 阿杰想用嘴吸伤口，又想找纸随便一包
shots.prompt_en: The young male student lifts his bleeding finger toward his mouth, then grabs a paper towel, looking unsure.
shots.narration: 他想吸一吸，再用纸巾随便一包。

shots.scene: 小研拦住，拿来急救箱
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student stops him and brings over a first aid kit from the wall.
shots.narration: 小研拦住他，拿来了急救箱。

shots.scene: 小研戴上手套，准备处理
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student puts on disposable gloves and opens the kit beside him.
shots.narration: 先戴手套，再按步骤处理。

shots.scene: 倒地的人旁边有冒烟和漏气
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person lying on the floor near a smoking bench and a leaking gas cylinder, a warning mark. No text.
shots.narration: 看到有人受伤，先看现场安不安全。

shots.scene: 冲进有毒区域救人，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a helper rushing into a gas cloud without a respirator to drag someone out, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 绝不冲进有毒、缺氧的区域。

shots.scene: 先停机断电，再靠近
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand pressing an emergency stop on a machine and switching off power before approaching an injured person. No text.
shots.narration: 机器伤人，先停机断电再靠近。

shots.scene: 施救者戴手套
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a helper putting on disposable gloves before touching a bleeding wound. No text.
shots.narration: 处理伤口，先戴一次性手套。

shots.scene: 轻拍肩膀大声呼唤
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a helper kneeling beside a lying person, tapping the shoulders and calling loudly. No text.
shots.narration: 轻拍呼唤，看他有没有反应。

shots.scene: 大声喊人帮忙
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the helper shouting for help with sound waves, two people running over. No text.
shots.narration: 大声喊人帮忙，不要一个人忙。

shots.scene: 一人拨打120，一人取急救箱
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one helper calling on a phone with an ambulance icon while another fetches a first aid kit. No text.
shots.narration: 让人拨打120，取来急救箱。

shots.scene: 没有反应、没有正常呼吸，开始心肺复苏
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an unresponsive person with no breathing icon and an arrow to chest compression hands. No text.
shots.narration: 没反应、没正常呼吸，马上心肺复苏。

shots.scene: 墙上醒目处的急救箱和急救点标志
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a first aid kit mounted on a lab wall at eye level under a first aid sign, nothing in front of it. No text.
shots.narration: 急救箱放在显眼、伸手可及的地方。

shots.scene: 【实拍】打开急救箱，逐样展示物品
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: hands open a first aid kit and show sterile gauze pads, bandages, adhesive plasters, tape, gloves, scissors and tweezers.
shots.narration: 纱布、绷带、创可贴、胶带、手套……

shots.scene: 三角巾、冰袋、洗眼液
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a triangular bandage, an instant cold pack and a bottle of sterile eye rinse solution laid out. No text.
shots.narration: 还有三角巾、冷敷袋、冲洗用水。

shots.scene: 急救箱上锁、前面堆物，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a locked first aid kit behind piled boxes, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 前面别堆东西，也别上锁。

shots.scene: 专人检查，用了就补，过期就换
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student checks the kit against a blank checklist and replaces an expired item.
shots.narration: 专人管理，用了就补，过期就换。

shots.scene: 每个人指向急救箱
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: several students in a lab all pointing toward the same first aid kit on the wall. No text.
shots.narration: 每个人都要知道急救箱在哪。

shots.scene: 参加急救培训，练习包扎
shots.prompt_en: Students practice bandaging each other's arms in a first aid training class led by the safety administrator.
shots.narration: 参加急救培训，学会清洗和包扎。

shots.scene: 箱里没有口服药，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pill bottle being taken by a student from a first aid kit, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不擅自给伤者用药。

shots.scene: 伤重别硬撑，拨打120
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pale injured person sitting down while a helper calls on a phone with an ambulance icon. No text.
shots.narration: 伤得重，别硬撑，马上拨打120。

shots.section_title: 割伤刺伤：冲洗按压包扎
shots.scene: 用嘴吸伤口、用手捡碎玻璃，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person sucking a cut finger and another picking up glass shards by hand, both crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 别用嘴吸伤口，别用手捡碎玻璃。
overlay: 割伤刺伤：冲洗按压包扎

shots.section_title: 割伤刺伤：冲洗按压包扎
shots.scene: 流动清水冲洗伤口
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cut finger held under running tap water at a sink. No text.
shots.narration: 先用流动清水冲洗伤口。

shots.section_title: 割伤刺伤：冲洗按压包扎
shots.scene: 【实拍】用干净纱布直接按压伤口（培训人员手部）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: gloved hands press a clean sterile gauze pad firmly on a partner's finger in a training session.
shots.narration: 用干净纱布按压，止血。

shots.section_title: 割伤刺伤：冲洗按压包扎
shots.scene: 止住后贴创可贴或包扎
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cut finger covered with a sterile dressing and wrapped with a small bandage. No text.
shots.narration: 血止住后，消毒包扎。

shots.section_title: 割伤刺伤：冲洗按压包扎
shots.scene: 玻璃碴在伤口里、伤口深，去医院
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a deep cut with a small glass shard inside, an arrow to a hospital icon. No text.
shots.narration: 伤口深、有玻璃碴、沾化学品，要就医。

shots.section_title: 割伤刺伤：冲洗按压包扎
shots.scene: 被用过的针头扎到
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a used needle pricking a finger, a biohazard warning sign beside it, an arrow to a report form. No text.
shots.narration: 被污染的针头扎到，按暴露处置。

shots.section_title: 出血多：用力按压快呼救
shots.scene: 血流不止，用力按压
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a helper pressing hard with both hands on a thick gauze pad over a bleeding forearm. No text.
shots.narration: 出血多，用纱布直接用力按压。
overlay: 出血多：用力按压快呼救

shots.section_title: 出血多：用力按压快呼救
shots.scene: 【实拍】绷带加压包扎（在训练伙伴前臂上）
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: gloved hands wrap an elastic bandage firmly over a gauze pad on a training partner's forearm.
shots.narration: 渗透了别揭开，再加纱布继续压。

shots.section_title: 出血多：用力按压快呼救
shots.scene: 扎进去的异物不拔，周围固定
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an object stuck in a forearm with gauze rolls placed around it, a hand pulling it out crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 扎进身体的东西别拔，周围垫好固定。

shots.section_title: 出血多：用力按压快呼救
shots.scene: 一边按压，一边拨打120
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: one helper keeps pressing on the wound while another calls on a phone with an ambulance icon. No text.
shots.narration: 一边按压，一边拨打120。

shots.scene: 手被热板烫到，马上到水龙头下冲
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a hand burned on a hot plate moved quickly under cool running tap water. No text.
shots.narration: 烫伤了，立即用流动冷水冲。

shots.scene: 持续冲，水流和时钟
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: cool water running over a burned hand with a clock icon showing time passing. No text.
shots.narration: 持续冷却足够时间，降温止痛。

shots.scene: 趁肿起来前摘下戒指手表
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a ring and a watch removed gently from a burned hand before swelling. No text.
shots.narration: 趁没肿，摘下戒指、手表。

shots.scene: 涂牙膏、酱油、油，挑破水泡，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: toothpaste, soy sauce, cooking oil and a needle near a blister, all crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 别涂牙膏酱油，别挑破水泡。

shots.scene: 盖上干净纱布
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cooled burn loosely covered with a clean sterile gauze pad. No text.
shots.narration: 冷却后，用干净纱布轻轻盖上。

shots.scene: 面积大、脸部、激光灼伤，就医
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a large burn on an arm, a burn on a face and a laser warning sign, each with an arrow to an ambulance. No text.
shots.narration: 面积大、在脸部或激光灼伤，就医。

shots.scene: 液氮溅到手上，皮肤发白
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: liquid nitrogen splashing on a hand, the skin patch turning pale white with a snowflake icon. No text.
shots.narration: 低温液体冻伤，皮肤会发白发硬。

shots.scene: 常温水慢慢冲，不用热水
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a frostbitten hand under lukewarm running water, a hot water tap and a hair dryer crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 用常温水慢慢复温，不用热水烤。

shots.scene: 揉搓冻伤处，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: hands rubbing a frostbitten patch of skin, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 不要揉搓，以免加重损伤。

shots.scene: 松开紧身物，就医
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a glove and a tight cuff loosened from a frostbitten hand, an arrow to a hospital icon. No text.
shots.narration: 松开手套袖口，冻伤要就医。

shots.section_title: 吸入误食：离开现场不催吐
shots.scene: 吸入蒸气头晕，移到新鲜空气处
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a dizzy person helped out of a fume-filled room to an open window with fresh air. No text.
shots.narration: 吸入蒸气，先离开到空气新鲜处。
overlay: 吸入误食：离开现场不催吐

shots.section_title: 吸入误食：离开现场不催吐
shots.scene: 保暖、安静，等待救援
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person resting quietly with a blanket over the shoulders, a helper beside him on the phone. No text.
shots.narration: 保暖、安静休息，呼叫120。

shots.section_title: 吸入误食：离开现场不催吐
shots.scene: 误食化学品，自行催吐，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person putting fingers in the throat to vomit after swallowing a chemical, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 误食了，不要自行催吐。

shots.section_title: 吸入误食：离开现场不催吐
shots.scene: 带上说明书立即就医
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a helper holding a safety data sheet and a bottle label, an arrow to an ambulance. No text.
shots.narration: 带上说明书或标签，立即就医。

shots.section_title: 吸入误食：离开现场不催吐
shots.scene: 昏迷者嘴里灌水，打叉
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: someone pouring water into the mouth of an unconscious person, crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 神志不清的人，不喂水不喂东西。

shots.scene: 休克的人脸色苍白、出冷汗
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a pale sweating person with a weak pulse icon and a dim oxygen icon. No text.
shots.narration: 休克时，身体供血供氧不足。

shots.scene: 脸色苍白、出冷汗、脉快、烦躁
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: icons of a pale face, cold sweat drops, a fast heartbeat and a confused face. No text.
shots.narration: 脸色苍白、冷汗、脉快，要警惕。

shots.scene: 平躺，盖上衣物保暖
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person lying flat on the floor covered with a coat, a helper beside him. No text.
shots.narration: 让他平躺，盖衣物保暖。

shots.scene: 拨打120，守在身边
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a helper calling on a phone with an ambulance icon while watching the lying person. No text.
shots.narration: 立即拨打120，守在身边观察。

shots.scene: 滑倒的小研坐在地上
shots.prompt_en: The female graduate student sits on the floor after slipping on a wet patch, holding her ankle.
shots.narration: 摔倒了，别马上跳起来。

shots.scene: 停一下，看看哪里疼
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person sitting still on the floor checking the ankle, wrist and head with question marks. No text.
shots.narration: 先停一下，看看哪里受伤。

shots.scene: 头晕或疼得厉害，喊人
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: the person on the floor with a dizzy icon calling out for help. No text.
shots.narration: 疼得厉害或头晕，马上求助。

shots.section_title: 骨折固定，脊柱伤不搬动
shots.scene: 疑似骨折，用夹板固定
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a forearm supported by a splint and a triangular bandage sling. No text.
shots.narration: 疑似骨折，别复位，就地固定。
overlay: 骨折固定，脊柱伤不搬动

shots.section_title: 骨折固定，脊柱伤不搬动
shots.scene: 固定伤处上下两个关节
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a splint along a lower leg tied above the knee and below the ankle, two check marks. No text.
shots.narration: 固定要超过伤处上下两个关节。

shots.section_title: 骨折固定，脊柱伤不搬动
shots.scene: 从高处摔下，颈背疼，不搬动
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person lying after a fall from a ladder, hands holding the head steady, a moving arrow crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 高处坠落、颈背疼，不要随意搬动。

shots.section_title: 骨折固定，脊柱伤不搬动
shots.scene: 除非现场危险，等专业人员
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an ambulance crew arriving with a stretcher and a neck collar. No text.
shots.narration: 除非现场危险，等专业人员来搬运。

shots.section_title: 昏迷有呼吸：侧卧防窒息
shots.scene: 昏迷但有呼吸，仰面躺着
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: an unconscious person lying on the back still breathing, a risk mark near the throat. No text.
shots.narration: 昏迷但有呼吸，仰躺容易堵住气道。
overlay: 昏迷有呼吸：侧卧防窒息

shots.section_title: 昏迷有呼吸：侧卧防窒息
shots.scene: 【实拍】把训练伙伴翻成侧卧位
shots.prompt_en: Close-up: a trainer rolls a training partner onto the side into the recovery position, the top knee bent and the head tilted.
shots.narration: 翻成侧卧，防止呕吐物堵住气道。

shots.section_title: 昏迷有呼吸：侧卧防窒息
shots.scene: 醉酒者不能一个人待着
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a drunk person lying on the side with a friend sitting beside him, an empty room crossed out. No text.
shots.narration: 喝醉的人，也侧躺，有人陪着。

shots.section_title: 昏迷有呼吸：侧卧防窒息
shots.scene: 叫不醒、呼吸异常，拨打120
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a person not waking with an irregular breath icon, a helper calling on a phone with an ambulance icon. No text.
shots.narration: 叫不醒、呼吸异常，马上拨打120。

shots.scene: 割伤、烫伤、碎玻璃，都报告
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a small cut, a small burn and broken glass, each with an arrow to a supervisor icon. No text.
shots.narration: 割伤烫伤，再小的伤也要报告。

shots.scene: 阿杰包好手指，告诉老周
shots.prompt_en: The young male student with a bandaged finger tells the older man what happened, the older man nodding.
shots.narration: 告诉负责人，如实记录经过。

shots.scene: 找出原因，整改
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a cracked beaker removed from a drying rack and a check mark on an inspection list. No text.
shots.narration: 查明原因，整改到位，防再受伤。

shots.scene: 盾牌和电话
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a shield icon and a phone with an ambulance icon. No text.
shots.narration: 先保安全，再呼救，再处理。

shots.scene: 按压、冷水、侧卧三个图标
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: three icons, hands pressing gauze, a hand under running water and a person in the recovery position. No text.
shots.narration: 出血按压，烫伤冷水冲，昏迷侧卧。

shots.scene: 急救箱和报告单
shots.prompt_en: Diagram: a well stocked first aid kit next to a report form with a check mark. No text.
shots.narration: 急救箱备齐会用，伤再小也报告。

shots.scene: 欣欣双手交叠放在训练模型胸前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot places its paws on the chest of a training manikin and waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 下一课：心肺复苏与AED。
